g.text: Years relative to release date (0 = release)
One row per release, ordered by release date (oldest at top). Black tick = today (2026-11-04); anything to its right is planned.
Ubuntu release life cycles aligned on each release date
Aligned on release, all releases share a ~6-month development lead-in, but life cycles split in two: interim releases get ~9 months of standard
support (median), LTS releases ~5 years, and from 14.04 LTS on LTS releases add ESM and legacy support out to 15 years.
